## Description

A clear and concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds game theory mechanics or UI polish)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (improving guides, README, or code comments)

## Validation Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes without errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit tests
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds

- [ ] Game theory mathematical integrity and payoff logic are preserved
- [ ] Audio and keyboard shortcuts function as intended
